rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury on the policyholder's property premises due to an icy condition, which is a classic liability claim arising from premises liability and the property owner's maintenance responsibilities.
claim_summary: Third-party liability claim: neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on the policyholder's icy front walkway during an ice storm last week. Parents are pursuing medical bills. High severity due to pediatric fracture requiring surgical and ongoing medical care.

case_facts.description: Child slipped and fell on icy walkway, broke wrist
